rows.text: I have stopped for the night. The car is locked and I have the keys. I will continue toward delivery in the morning.
I am taking my overnight rest now. The vehicle is locked, and its keys are still with me. I will send a fresh ETA tomorrow.
Navigation says twenty minutes to the vehicle gate for CD-420342. The cutoff looks comfortable from here.
Je dépasserai le créneau de réception initial. Je peux reprendre la route après la pause prévue, mais il me faut un nouvel horaire de remise avec quelqu'un sur place.
J'approuve le créneau de livraison plus tardif. Veuillez confirmer directement que quelqu'un à l'adresse privée pourra recevoir la voiture et les clés.

I understand the receiving contact is unavailable over the weekend. I have the vehicle locked and its keys with me. I plan to request an attended handover on Monday; I have not sent a parking location.
I am not available to take the Helsinki delivery myself. Our receiving lead may cover, but I need the buyer to authorize who can inspect and sign before you change the driver instruction.
Tiistai 20.10. käy. Vastaanotto on paikalla klo 13–14 ja ottaa auton sekä avaimet vastaan.
Can you send the signed delivery proof for CD-420164? The car reached the receiving address, but the handover file is not in our inbox.
For CD-420015, our order form names Elena Alderbrook, but the branch has not confirmed that contact will release the keys. Can you check?
The photos help, but accounting specifically needs the signed handover record.
The pickup contact says reception has the keys for CD-420516; the pickup note still tells the driver to use the side gate.
Der Ferrari Roma steht bei uns in der Filiale, aber der Verkäufer hat die unterschriebene Freigabe für CD-420458 noch nicht zurückgeschickt.
The selected collection slot is still fine. We only need the driver sent to the right person.
Ich habe beim Verkäufer nachgefragt. Vielleicht kommt die Freigabe heute Nachmittag, versprechen kann ich es noch nicht.
Can you confirm that CD-420111 reached the receiving address?
Is the handover file for CD-420020 ready for our records?
Can you confirm the current collection window for CD-420384?
Can you reserve a collector for CD-420009? The vehicle details are still with our seller.
Should I tell the buyer a driver is confirmed for CD-420537?
For CD-420437, the receiving contact in Munich is available only until early afternoon on the planned date.
Should I tell the buyer a driver is confirmed for CD-420118?
We can discuss another slot if the driver cannot make it safely.
Our buyer sees the prepared CMR for the Cologne to Odense car. Can they treat that as signed?
I am unwell this morning. I may not be fit to collect CD-420449 in the booked slot; I can confirm by early evening.
Does a delivery target mean the vehicle has left the pickup site?
Vaihtoauto ja avaimet vastaanotettu klo 13.50. Vastaanotto kuittasi auton; luovutuskuvat voitte tarkistaa erikseen.
I will update you before 18:00. Do not cancel the gig yet.
Understood. Please leave the file as prepared until the driver has the physical signatures.

I checked vehicle SYNHU89YZ8GSW6CKB against the release list when it left our desk. The driver photographed the neighbouring car first. I can confirm which car left, but I did not take condition photos for you.
I am already away from the pickup branch with this car. I can take new vehicle photos at the next safe stop, but they would not show its pickup condition.
Has the pickup time for CD-420585 been selected from the available window?
When will the car reach Frankfurt?
I corrected the charging claim on CD-420326. The old submission still appears in my history. Will both be paid?
The hotel offered to park the car and keep its key until morning. I have not handed the key over. Is that allowed before the ferry?
I am stopping for rest before the remaining drive to the terminal. The vehicle is with me. I will check the route again in the morning; I have not reached check-in.
I could take CD-420404 if the fee were EUR 190. I have not booked it. Can you check before the offer closes?
The destination is in another time zone. Which local delivery range should they use?
Can CD-420201 be collected this morning instead of next week and delivered tomorrow? The source branch told us the car is ready now.
I can collect in that slot and deliver tomorrow if the car is there.
Yes, use 09:00-11:00 local time today at the existing Munich branch and 10:00-15:00 local tomorrow for delivery. The seller told us the car could be released this morning.
Can you confirm which purchase-order reference was attached to CD-420194? Our accounts team cannot match the delivery.
For CD-420347: Our handover sheet names a vehicle yard, but the booking says to wait outside the showroom. Where should collection start?
For this delivery I authorize Lena Alderbrook, our receiving lead, to inspect the car, sign the handover and take the keys. Wilfred is away and should not be used as the recipient.

I am Lena Alderbrook, the receiving lead for this delivery. I will be at the recorded Helsinki address and can sign for the vehicle and take the keys. Please ask the driver to call me on arrival; I will meet them at the door.

I can see the booking, but our collection screen says showroom handover and the handover sheet says the nearby yard. I cannot confirm where this car or its keys are. Stock control will check the vehicle record and call us back by 14:00 local time today. Please do not send a driver before we confirm the collection point.
That helps. Please tell us if the billing record needs a correction after you check.
The queue before the terminal has barely moved. The booked crossing for CD-420603 may close before I reach check-in.
When will the car reach Tampere?
I am at Velantora Helsinki for CD-420593. Reception cannot find the BMW M4 in the handover list.
The receiving team has noticed a mark on the rear panel of CD-420455. Can you tell us whether it was there at collection?
I am at the agreed reception desk. Staff cannot find the car matching CD-420201. I have not taken keys or moved a vehicle.
The buyer withdrew and the Volvo V60 sale is cancelled. Please stop tomorrow's collection.
I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
Tämä on ensimmäinen kuljetuksemme. Onko CD-421010 jo kuljettajan vastuulla?
The car is not in our release queue. I can see a similar stock reference, but I cannot hand it over without confirmation.
Confirmed: cancel the collection. The car will stay with us.
There is also a parking claim from this trip. Please keep that separate from the charging correction.
I am still in the queue with the car. I have not turned toward another terminal.
Pour CD-420656, le véhicule ne sera pas libéré à la date prévue. Peut-on décaler l'enlèvement de deux jours ?
We checked our release list and the yard with the driver. We cannot locate the vehicle on this order and will not release another car.
I can collect from Marseille tomorrow if my trip there is confirmed. Please send the actual travel booking, not just a suggested route.
Our system still lists this branch. I am calling the stock team now; please do not substitute a different car.
The receiving contact says the Bentley Continental GT from CD-420055 arrived with a mark they did not expect. Can you check the handover photos?
Selvä. Odotamme varaustietoa ennen kuin valmistelemme luovutuksen.
Understood. I had not bought travel or left for Hamburg, so I have no cost to submit.
I have not reached the Espoo transfer yard. I cannot get there before its 11:00 local staffed release cutoff; please do not leave the car waiting for me.
Le service de préparation attend encore une pièce. Je n'ai pas de date ferme de leur part.
We still have no name from the branch. Please tell us who is checking it before anyone travels.
I did not hear a condition concern at the desk. I cannot tell from memory whether the mark was visible at pickup.
The key desk on CD-420516 is still unclear. Did the site contact confirm it?
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
I can wait another 30 minutes. After that I need a new plan for my travel back.
I am following up on the release for CD-420458; the signer has not sent it yet.
The receiving contact still cannot take CD-420437 after early afternoon. Is the driver on course?
I am still unsure whether I will be well enough to drive CD-420449.
I have stopped the Bentley Continental GT on CD-420322. A red warning came on and the car felt different when accelerating.
The later sailing can work for me if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. I have not changed my pickup time.

For Thursday we see CD-420154 and CD-420689 in the same collection window. Our release desk needs the driver and document set for each vehicle separately. Friday's CD-420656 and CD-420692 are a separate handover queue; please do not roll Thursday's release instruction forward.
Our accounts team is asking again for the signed handover on CD-420164.
The receiving partner has now sent two photos of the left rear mark. They cannot confirm when they first noticed it.
The staffed 09:00-11:00 release window has ended. No collector checked in for this car, and the car and keys remain on our yard register. We have not released them to the booked driver.

We received the returned trade-in for CD-420177 yesterday. CD-420941 is listed for Friday collection and CD-420413 for Monday. Please send the vehicle references and key contacts separately; the returned car is not one of those outbound releases.
Please keep the agreed attended delivery window. If the route cannot make it, send the revised date and reason for approval before contacting the recipient at the home address.

I am still on CD-420326, heading toward Hamburg. After that handover I need my rest. My first time to travel is after 12:00 tomorrow local time, so I cannot reach the selected Leipzig collection slot. I have no travel booking. Please check a replacement or ask the customer about another slot.
The car and keys are still with our staffed yard. We can release them to a replacement driver tomorrow, 22 October, between 09:00 and 11:00 local time after an ID and condition check.
I am safe at a service-area car park. The engine is off. I can send a dashboard photo, but I have not diagnosed the issue.
I have asked the branch for a close photo and the time they first noticed it. Please wait for that before concluding anything.

Reception does not have the keys for this car. The side gate is only for vehicle entry, not a collection desk. Our stock screen lists a warehouse transfer but no named person to release the vehicle. I cannot confirm the handover point or key holder for the selected slot; please hold a driver until stock control checks this car.
Cancel CD-420201. We will investigate where the car is and make a new request if it is found. Please release the driver.

The car is at our branch, but the seller has withdrawn permission to hand it over while the invoice remains unsettled. We have no signed release for this vehicle. Do not send a driver even if the old collection note is still visible; our desk will refuse the handover until the seller clears the hold and sends a signed authority.
Please keep the vehicle stopped. I will ask our service contact whether it needs roadside assistance or collection.
Correction to my earlier message: the delivery address can be accessed until 18:00 local today. I still cannot confirm who is authorized to inspect and sign for the car.

I accepted the two Golf job, CD-420413 then CD-420384. The first car ends at the same Tampere branch where the second begins the next day. Am I meant to collect the second set of keys on Monday and keep the car overnight?
I paid 12 EUR for parking while waiting at the branch. I have submitted the receipt; please review it.
Understood. I will only collect the first Golf on Monday. Please tell me who confirms Tuesday's keys and where I should report.
I will wait here. Please tell me who is collecting the car before anyone moves it.
